sample_unit: AI responses (9 guideline questions x 4 models)

links.outcome: Concordance with AAOS meniscal guidelines: evidence-grounded OpenEvidence versus general LLMs
links.effect: OpenEvidence 9/9 (100%) vs ChatGPT 8/9 (89%), Gemini and Claude 7/9 (78%); Cochran's Q = 3.00, p = 0.392, so no significant difference.
links.quote: Cochran's Q test showed no significant difference among models (Q = 3.00, p = 0.392).

links.outcome: Concordance of LLM clinical recommendations with current AAOS guidelines
links.effect: Overall concordance 86% (31/36); 100% for strong/consensus recommendations, 75% for moderate/limited; general LLMs not consistently guideline-concordant.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the concordance of several general LLMs and a domain-specific LLM tool against clinical practice guidelines for meniscal pathology without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
